sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Garden is a three-in-a-row puzzle game, where players must collect the same game elements from three or more figures in columns or rows. The game's intuitive controls and responsive interface make it easy to pick up and play, allowing players to focus on the puzzle at hand. As you progress through levels, new game elements and mechanics are introduced, adding depth and complexity to the gameplay experience.

One of the key mechanics in Garden is the ability to combine game elements to create new ones. This adds a strategic layer to the game, as players must carefully plan their moves to clear the board and create new opportunities. The game also features a variety of obstacles and challenges, such as locked tiles and special power-ups, which must be overcome by combining game elements in creative ways.

The game's core mechanics are simple yet addictive, making it easy for players to pick up and play, yet challenging enough to keep them engaged for hours on end. With its focus on pattern recognition, spatial reasoning, and strategic planning, Garden is a great game for players who enjoy puzzle games and are looking for a new challenge.
